exam_scheme.note: The ICAR All India Entrance Examination for Admission (ICAR AIEEA-PG) is conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) for admission to 30% of seats in Master's degree programmes across State Agricultural Universities (SAUs), Central Agricultural Universities (CAUs), ICAR Deemed Universities (IARI, IVRI, NDRI, CIFE), and Central Universities with agricultural faculties, as well as for the award of ICAR-PG Scholarship / National Talent Scholarship (NTS). The examination is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) of 120 minutes (2 hours) duration. The question paper consists of 120 multiple-choice questions carrying a total of 480 marks across 20 Major Subject Groups. Marking scheme: 4 marks awarded for each correct response, 1 mark deducted for each incorrect response (-1 negative marking), and 0 marks for unattempted questions.
